finding: Full raw metrics remain G=0/8 and E_reference=0/8. Four returned bodies decode and pass physical checks under diagnostic first-END grading; all four preserve every non-lattice plan field, while none exactly matches the three requested scale values. Their causes are numerical scaling errors, not unchanged copied lengths. The remaining four rows retain their original raw-output failures: one duplicate-END boundary failure and three body decoder/grammar failures. First-END parsing is diagnostic only and does not alter strict metrics; no tolerance was relaxed or output repaired.
